transcript: Cristiano Ronaldo. In my mind, I'm always the best. King Kohli. I have to believe that I'm the best. Shah Rukh Khan. I am the best. Three different people, three different fields. But whenever they stood in front of the camera, they said one thing: I am the best. And that isn't a coincidence. But you, you wake up every day and tell yourself that you are not good enough, that you are not talented enough. You just say wrong things to yourself. Every great performer shares one exact same trait: the extraordinary belief that whatever they do, they will do the best. And that's not a bonus quality, but it's a need if you want an extraordinary life. Now, don't get this twisted. It's okay not to be the best, but never talk negatively about yourself. Why? Because your subconscious mind doesn't know the difference. Whatever you keep telling your mind, accept it as a reality. And that's why Bruce Lee insisted this, too. He asked everyone to repeat these five affirmations every day. I am the best. I can do it alone. God is always with me. I am a winner. Today is my day. They know that their words are magical, and that's why it's called spells. And what they believe and what they manifest is what they get. So tell yourself that you have actually achieved everything, because nobody has achieved something extraordinary by thinking that they are average. So you have to tell yourself big things, but have bigger guts to achieve that. And don't worry if people judge you for this, because the same people who laugh at you today are the ones who will come to you later and call themselves your friend. I hope you understood. So this is Garvit, and you will see me again.
